cumulative_estimand: sum of horizon-specific period coefficients, retaining Phase2A samples
bootstrap: noncircular moving-block pairs of calendar-indexed design vectors; full OLS refit via exact row multiplicities; shared indices within sample
primary_multiplicity: BH within each outcome 13 period horizons
mechanism_families: each shock/outcome/control specification separately; Link1 four oil lag coefficients within each quantity/bandwidth specification; cumulative and joint tests separate singleton families
extra_families: hierarchy nine contrasts; joint four windows per primary outcome; no cross-question pooling
wording_policy: ROBUST_ASSOCIATION requires primary q<.05 and primary bootstrap percentile CI excluding zero and stable CI sign in both block sensitivities and HAC sensitivities; SUGGESTIVE_ASSOCIATION if primary raw p<.05 or primary bootstrap CI excludes zero; otherwise NO_CLEAR_EVIDENCE; shares DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
share_width_policy: delete headline percentages if primary percentile interval width exceeds 20 percentage points; no structural weights
limitations: pointwise intervals; joint/hierarchy/secondary tests distinct questions; no structural break or causal identification
